reconciliationRationale: Historical references citing '78 migrations' confused the highest lexicographical prefix '078' with the cardinal migration file count. The migrations use subsystem prefix ranges (001: system keyspaces, 01x: identity, 02x: learning, 03x: classroom, 04x: assessment, 05x: interaction, 06x: AI, 07x: audit/notification/analytics/credentials). There are exactly 44 distinct migration files in dev/ and 44 in research/ for a total of 88 CQL files.

001_keyspaces.cql.reason: dev uses ailss_dc:1 (single-node development container) whereas research uses ailss_dc:3 (3-node production replication strategy).

023_learning_course_offerings.cql.reason: Formatting and line-wrapping variance; schema definition and column types are identical.

024_learning_entitlement_commerce.cql.reason: Single comment line difference ('-- P7.12C-approved additive Q-LRN-013 saga columns.'); CQL statements are byte-equivalent.

033_classroom_student_schedule.cql.reason: Explicit vs default compaction options specified; table schema structure and primary keys are identical.

043_assessment_submit.cql.reason: Line ordering and whitespace variance; CQL statement payloads are identical.

062_ai_quiz_generation.cql.reason: Statement ordering between ALTER TABLE and CREATE TABLE; final keyspace schema state is identical.
